categories.main_business_segments: Xinjiang Daqo New Energy Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of high-purity polysilicon, which is a key upstream material in the photovoltaic (solar energy) industry. The company also produces silicon core products, trichlorosilane, silicon tetrachloride, sodium hydroxide, hydrochloric acid, sodium hypochlorite, and processes silicon iron, silicon manganese, silicon powder, and silicon alloys. It operates mainly in the photovoltaic materials manufacturing sector.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company uses the improved Siemens process combined with cold hydrogenation technology for polysilicon production, which is a mature and advanced chemical process involving the reaction of metallurgical-grade silicon with hydrogen chloride to produce trichlorosilane, followed by purification, reduction, and product recovery steps. The company continuously optimizes key processes such as cold hydrogenation fluidized bed, distillation advanced process control (APC), and reduction furnace intelligent control to reduce costs and improve product quality. Digitalization and intelligent manufacturing are also core to its production methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are downstream silicon wafer manufacturers in the photovoltaic industry, including producers of monocrystalline and polycrystalline silicon wafers. The company serves mainly the solar energy sector, providing high-purity polysilicon materials used in solar cells and modules. It also targets semiconductor-grade polysilicon markets, aiming to break foreign monopolies and expand into high-end applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with production bases in Xinjiang and Inner Mongolia. It also actively expands overseas markets and has established long-term cooperation with multiple foreign customers. Its sales cover major regions in China including North China, Northwest, Southwest, East China, South China, Northeast, Central China, and overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xinjiang Daqo New Energy is positioned upstream in the photovoltaic supply chain as a polysilicon manufacturer. It produces the raw polysilicon material that is further processed into silicon wafers and solar cells downstream. The company is also expanding upstream into industrial silicon and silicon core materials and horizontally into semiconductor polysilicon and organic silicon sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on technological innovation to reduce production costs, improve product quality, and enhance energy efficiency. Key R&D directions include optimizing cold hydrogenation, distillation APC, reduction furnace control, and impurity removal technologies. It invests in digital twin technology for production system management and emphasizes green, low-carbon manufacturing. The company also pursues semiconductor-grade polysilicon development and collaborates with universities and research institutes to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-purity polysilicon products to downstream silicon wafer manufacturers under long-term supply agreements. The company also earns income from sales of by-products and other related chemical products. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance, with contracts typically involving prepayments and monthly pricing adjustments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading polysilicon producers in China, ranking in the first tier with an 11.26% share of domestic polysilicon production in 2024. It competes on cost leadership, product quality, and technological innovation. The industry is highly competitive with increasing capacity and price pressures, but the company maintains a strong position due to its scale, advanced technology, and cost advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 7.41 billion, a 54.62% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.72 billion, reflecting significant industry price declines. The company has a production capacity of 305,000 tons of high-purity polysilicon annually. Despite the downturn, it maintains substantial cash reserves of about RMB 13.52 billion and continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D. The company’s asset base includes fixed assets valued at over RMB 25 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xinjiang Daqo New Energy emphasizes high-quality, low-energy-consumption, and low-cost polysilicon production with products meeting international advanced standards. Over 98% of its polysilicon is suitable for monocrystalline silicon wafers, with a significant portion reaching semiconductor-grade purity. The company leverages advanced manufacturing technologies, digitalization, and environmental sustainability to provide reliable, high-purity polysilicon that supports the global photovoltaic industry’s transition to clean energy.
